# Fairview Ogden Medical Group (FOMG)

> Independent adult primary care, internal medicine, onsite diagnostic sleep laboratory, and comprehensive ultrasound imaging clinic located in Downers Grove, Illinois.

## Core Information
- **Practice Name**: Fairview Ogden Medical Group
- **Address**: 4121 Fairview Ave, Suite L1, Downers Grove, IL 60515
- **Phone**: (630) 968-4790
- **Fax**: (630) 968-8755
- **Website**: https://fairviewogdenmed.com
- **Online Booking (All Physicians)**: https://livewell.aah.org/chart/openscheduling/standalone?id=41240&dept=525605256101
- **Languages Spoken**: English, Urdu, Hindi, Arabic

## Board-Certified Physicians
- **Dr. Zainulabuddin Syed, MD**: Board-certified in Internal Medicine with 20+ years experience. Specializes in adult primary care, chronic disease management, and preventative health. Affiliated with Advocate Good Samaritan Hospital and UChicago Medicine AdventHealth Hinsdale.
- **Dr. Abdul-Bari Syed, DO**: Board-certified in Internal Medicine and experienced hospitalist with nearly 20 years experience. Specializes in acute inpatient medicine, complex adult care, and sleep medicine.
- **Dr. Ravikiran N. Tamragouri, MD, FACP**: Board-certified in Internal Medicine and Fellow of the American College of Physicians (FACP) with decades of clinical excellence. Specializes in geriatric medicine and complex chronic conditions.

## Clinical Specialties & Diagnostics Under One Roof
- **Internal Medicine & Adult Primary Care**: Annual physicals, preventive screenings, Type 2 diabetes management, hypertension, high cholesterol, asthma/COPD, acute infections, polypharmacy medication reviews, travel medicine.
- **Onsite Diagnostic Sleep Laboratory**: Overnight polysomnography (PSG) sleep studies in private hotel-grade suites for Sleep Apnea (OSA), insomnia, restless legs syndrome (RLS), and CPAP titration.
- **Onsite Diagnostic Ultrasound**: Echocardiograms (heart function & valve evaluation), Carotid Artery Doppler (stroke prevention), abdominal ultrasound (liver, gallstones, kidneys), thyroid scans, and abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) screenings.

## Accepted Insurance & Payment
- **Medicare**: Accepted for primary care, sleep studies, and diagnostic imaging.
- **Commercial Insurance**: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois (BCBS IL), Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Humana, MultiPlan, Caterpillar, and most major PPO/HMO networks.
- **Self-Pay / Copays**: Direct cash and credit card payment accepted.

## Geographic Service Area
Serving Downers Grove (60515, 60516) and surrounding western Chicago suburbs in DuPage County, Illinois: Westmont, Hinsdale, Clarendon Hills, Lisle, Oak Brook, Elmhurst, Woodridge, Darien, Lombard, and Naperville.
